title: Compare Sums of Bitonic Parts
goal: Solve Compare Sums of Bitonic Parts: Locate the shared peak, accumulate both inclusive sides, and compare their sums.
strategy: Locate the shared peak, accumulate both inclusive sides, and compare their sums.

phasePurposes.peak: Identify the inclusive boundary shared by both parts.
phasePurposes.right: Include the peak through the last index.
phasePurposes.done: Return 0, 1, or −1 according to the larger sum.

edgeCases: The peak belongs to both inclusive sums. Equal sums return -1; equal neighboring values and an upward turn after descending are rejected.
inputRules: Enter a JSON array of 3–100,000 integers, each between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
Use a single peak: no equal neighbors or upward turn after descending.
